question:
The following bar graph presents the number of cases of COVID in four states of India n the year 2022.

How much percent cases are more in Karnataka than Kerala?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bb8746c3116c82ba0829e6b789b626146cca7ee1bddf48ff80c234f17d94aab.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Differences in the number of cases of COVID in Kerala and Karnataka

⇒ 156000 - 120000 = 36000

Difference % = (Differences in the number of cases of COVID in Kerala and Karnataka/ the number of cases of COVID in Kerala) × 100

⇒ (36000/120000) × 100

⇒ 30%

**∴ The correct answer is 30%.**
